question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"negative".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Negative" **means having a harmful or unfavorable effect. It is the opposite of **"positive".**
 
• In grammar, **"negative" **can refer to a type of sentence that expresses the absence or denial of something.
 
 
• **For example, **"I don't like pizza" is a negative sentence.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **"Positive", **means having a beneficial or favorable effect. It is the opposite of** "negative"**.
 
• **"Neutral", **means having no particular positive or negative effect. It is in **between "positive" and "negative".**
 
• **"Negligible", **means so small or unimportant as to be not worth considering. It is similar to **"insignificant".**
